features.name: url_suspicion_score
features.description: Weighted sum of URL-based indicators: IP address usage, URL length anomaly, shortening service, at-symbol, double-slash redirect, and prefix-suffix dash. Higher values indicate more suspicious URL structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth linear projection of URL-level phishing signals directly usable by SVM margin optimization.
features.formula: (-1 * having_IP_Address.astype(float)) + (-1 * URL_Length.astype(float)) + (-1 * Shortining_Service.astype(float)) + (-1 * having_At_Symbol.astype(float)) + (-1 * double_slash_redirecting.astype(float)) + (-1 * Prefix_Suffix.astype(float))

features.name: ssl_domain_trust_score
features.description: Composite trust score combining SSL state, domain registration length, age of domain, and DNS record presence. Higher values indicate more trustworthy domain infrastructure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures domain legitimacy signals in a single continuous score suitable for linear SVM decision boundaries.

features.name: content_behavior_score
features.description: Weighted composite of content-level behavioral indicators: request URL ratio, anchor URL behavior, links in tags, SFH form handler, and submitting to email. Reflects how page content behaves.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates page content signals into a smooth continuous feature for linear margin separation.

features.name: web_reputation_score
features.description: Composite of web reputation signals: web traffic rank, page rank, Google index status, links pointing to page, and statistical report. Higher values indicate better established web presence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized reputation signal that linearly separates legitimate from phishing sites based on external validation.

features.name: browser_exploit_score
features.description: Sum of browser-level exploit indicators: mouseover manipulation, right-click disabling, popup windows, iframe usage, and redirect count. Higher values indicate more browser manipulation attempts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures client-side attack vectors in a single continuous score for linear SVM feature space.

features.name: overall_phishing_risk_index
features.description: Global phishing risk index combining all 30 features with equal weighting. Negative values in original encoding indicate phishing signals, so this sum captures overall risk direction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single most informative linear projection of all features; directly approximates the optimal linear SVM hyperplane direction.
features.formula: having_IP_Address.astype(float) + URL_Length.astype(float) + Shortining_Service.astype(float) + having_At_Symbol.astype(float) + double_slash_redirecting.astype(float) + Prefix_Suffix.astype(float) + having_Sub_Domain.astype(float) + SSLfinal_State.astype(float) + Domain_registeration_length.astype(float) + Favicon.astype(float) + port.astype(float) + HTTPS_token.astype(float) + Request_URL.astype(float) + URL_of_Anchor.astype(float) + Links_in_tags.astype(float) + SFH.astype(float) + Submitting_to_email.astype(float) + Abnormal_URL.astype(float) + Redirect.astype(float) + on_mouseover.astype(float) + RightClick.astype(float) + popUpWidnow.astype(float) + Iframe.astype(float) + age_of_domain.astype(float) + DNSRecord.astype(float) + web_traffic.astype(float) + Page_Rank.astype(float) + Google_Index.astype(float) + Links_pointing_to_page.astype(float) + Statistical_report.astype(float)

features.name: url_anomaly_density
features.description: Ratio of negative URL indicators to total URL features checked. Measures the proportion of URL features flagged as suspicious, normalized to [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized ratio feature ideal for SVM; captures density of URL-level anomalies independent of feature count.

features.name: domain_legitimacy_ratio
features.description: Ratio of positive domain trust indicators to total domain features. Measures proportion of domain features indicating legitimacy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized ratio capturing domain legitimacy proportion; well-suited for linear SVM margin computation.

features.name: subdomain_ssl_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between subdomain complexity and SSL state. Captures the combined effect of subdomain depth and certificate validity as a product signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Nonlinear interaction encoded as a product feature, enabling linear SVM to capture joint subdomain-SSL phishing patterns.

features.name: content_external_resource_risk
features.description: Interaction between request URL external loading and anchor URL behavior. Captures combined risk when both external resources and anchor links show suspicious patterns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Product interaction feature that highlights co-occurring content risks, providing additional linear separability for SVM.

features.name: semantic_url_credibility
features.description: Semantic assessment of URL credibility based on combination of IP address usage, shortening service, HTTPS token misuse, and at-symbol presence. Score from 0 (highly suspicious) to 1 (highly credible) based on how many of these four key URL credibility signals are clean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantically grounded credibility score that complements formula features with expert-encoded URL trustworthiness assessment.

features.name: infrastructure_maturity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of website infrastructure maturity combining domain age, DNS record validity, page rank, web traffic, and Google indexing. Ranges from 0 (immature/suspicious infrastructure) to 1 (mature/established infrastructure), reflecting how well-established the site appears across multiple independent signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic infrastructure maturity as a smooth continuous score, providing SVM with a semantically meaningful axis of separation between established and newly-created sites.
